turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: So what brings you here today at the family clinic?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I haven't been coughing these last two weeks since I got back from Mexico. I think I got sick there.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so just the last couple weeks you've been coughing?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, ever since I got back from Mexico it's been yeah so about about two weeks.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And is your cough for a wet cough or dry cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It's dry and I'm not bringing up any any sputum.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and are you coughing up any blood at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No blood.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. And is the cough constant or does it come and go?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It, it comes and goes. I would say sometimes it can be worse. Yeah, depending on on what I'm what I'm doing. I guess if I'm exercising or if it's if it's really cold outside, it might get worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you feel that it's been getting worse at all, your cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, not really, I think it's about the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and anything that you did when you were in Mexico that might you think might have caused your cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, I don't know, maybe I, I was drinking a little bit too much and partying a little bit too much so might have got sick while I was there.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: I see. Did you have any cold symptoms like runny nose, sore throat? Um, any anything like that when you were there or after you came back?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, sometimes my eyes can get a little itchy, but no runny nose or sore throat.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had any previous episodes that are similar to how you're feeling now?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, maybe years ago when I like when I was in elementary school, but nothing for the last few years.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how often are you coughing? Let's say in an average day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, it's uh, it's pretty variable. I would say, so if I'm exercising it will it'll throw me into a coughing fit and and sometimes it's really bugging me at night too it'll affect me. It's impairing my sleep.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and so exercise makes it worse. Anything that you do that helps you relieve the cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, I actually I tried my sons inhaler and it seemed to actually help, but one of the days I just couldn't seem to stop the cough and I wanted to sleep so I gave it a try and it it seemed to actually help with the cough.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and so your son has inhalers, does he have asthma?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah he does. Yeah he was diagnosed with asthma a couple of years ago.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you previously been diagnosed with asthma?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah I think if they've said it before when I was young, but I haven't had any symptoms for for for years.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and besides the cough, do you have any other symptoms, like any cold symptoms of runny nose, sore throat right now, or even like any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you have any symptoms like a headache or nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, nope. No headache, nausea or vomiting.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Is your cough at all worse during the day or at night? Or does it just is at around the same throughout the day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I think the coughs worse at night.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you ever feel that you're short of breath at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Well, yeah, so it affects me if I'm outside and that that's actually usually when my eyes will get itchy too.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you had any eczema in the past?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah I had, I had eczema when I was I was younger. I think that was in it when I was in elementary school as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you had any fevers or chills recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any night sweats?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you been feeling increasingly tired throughout the day?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Ah no, my energy's been been good I just get short of breath or or have these coughing fits if I, if I exert myself.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you noticed any swelling in your feet or hands?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any dizziness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No dizziness.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Do you ever feel your heart is racing when you get like these thumping like heart palpitations?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, nothing like that.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and you said no chest pain, right?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No chest pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Have you noticed any changes in your bowel movements? Any constipation or diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No diarrhea.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any changes in your urinary patterns?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, everything's been normal.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so you mentioned like the coughs been keeping you up at night. How, how often are you waking up at night? Is it pretty frequent?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I would say about two or three nights a week over these last two weeks. It's been, it's been getting worse.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you noticed any changes in your weight at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: My weight's been about the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, any changes in your appetite?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, been eating well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any recent exposures to anyone with tuberculosis that you know of?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: No, OK. Have you lost your sense of taste or smell recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Neither of those.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you been exposed to any fumes or dust in your surrounding area, or do you have any pets or animals at home?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, we have a, uh, two cats. And, but nothing at work.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And how long you've had those cats for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: We've had them for for almost a year.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And other than eczema and remote history of perhaps asthma when you were younger, any other medical conditions like diabetes or high blood pressure that you've been diagnosed with?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I've been healthy that way.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Any medications that you are on currently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no medications.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you know of any allergies to any environmental exposures or any medications at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm yeah, I think I have, I'm allergic to pollen and some other environmental and allergies as well.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and when you cough, have you ever noticed like wheezing noises at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh occasionally yeah, there, though I do notice a wheeze.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And have you ever been hospitalized before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I haven't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Ok, any previous surgeries?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No surgeries.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And has anyone around you been ill recently?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Everybody's been healthy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you have any family history of cancers or anything related to the lungs at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no. I mean, my sister had eczema as well, but that's it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, that's it. OK, uh, any heart attacks in your family? Any other medical conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no. Everyone's healthy.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK and currently what is your living situation like?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I live in an apartment nearby with my boyfriend.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and has there been any, have you moved there recently or how long have you lived there for?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh we've lived there for about four years now.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Four years, OK. And has anything changed recently? Has there been any mold or new carpets that you guys got anything new in the house?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, I don't, I don't think so.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you currently work?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I work as a a school teacher.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you smoke at all?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you ever smoked?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I did, yeah I, I smoked a pack a day up until just about a month ago. I made, it was a New Year's resolution to quit.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Oh wow, well congratulations, that's it's definitely very difficult to quit. And if you need at all, any help at all with your transition at all, we can always bring it up in any appointment.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah. And in terms of recreational drugs, do you use marijuana or cocaine or any other recreational drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Um, yeah, maybe I'll I'll smoke like one or two joints a week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, yeah, maybe a bottle of wine on the weekends.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Uhm, so you go through like around a bottle every week?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I would say about a bottle of wine on throughout the week, but usually don't really have any during the week, I'll usually, I guess, split the bottle between between Friday to Sunday sort of thing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And in terms of exercise, do you find that you're getting adequate exercise throughout the week?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I tried to, I tried to run and go for walks but always trying to be a little bit more active.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. Alright, so yeah those are all the questions I had for you today. Um, do you have any other questions for me?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, nope, that was it.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so based on what we talked about, it seems that based on your past history and the coughing that you're having right now, one of the things that we definitely want to look at is if you do in fact have asthma. Um, it can also be like viral upper respiratory tract infection, but we will do some pulmonary function tests for you and see if the bronchodilators just like you use the inhaler from your son if that helps helps you with your symptoms and then we can go from there.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: That sounds great. Thank you.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: You're welcome. Well, take care.
